methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's AI Ready RVA partnership signals institutional investment in distributed AI education and community impact, potentially building deep local capability beyond just platform adoption if it extends beyond university boundaries into Richmond's broader workforce.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - MSN
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce suggests rapid platform-driven adoption creating shallow engagement rather than deep capability development, as workers adapt to AI tools without necessarily building foundational AI literacy.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: On-demand ed2go workforce training represents pre-packaged platform delivery to rural regions—broad access but shallow depth, signaling distribution without the peer networks or deep learning that would characterize 'Build It Yourself.'

signals.title: Army awards $869M contract to Leidos
signals.signal_reading: The $869M Leidos Army AI contract reinforces NoVA's concentration of deep technical capability in defense AI, pulling specialized talent and resources toward the metro hub rather than distributing knowledge across Virginia's regions.

signals.title: Norfolk Southern deploys AI system to catch wheel defects before they break - The Business Journals
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk Southern's AI deployment for predictive maintenance demonstrates applied AI capability in Hampton Roads' industrial base, but as corporate implementation rather than distributed workforce fluency—deep but concentrated in specific employers.
